title: Tensor triangular geometry of band algebras
summary: In this paper, we study the tensor triangular geometry of band algebras $RB$, where $B$ is a finite left regular band and $R$ is a commutative Noetherian ring. We show that the Balmer spectrum of $\Perf(RB)$ is homeomorphic to $\Spec R\times L_B$, where $L_B$ is the support lattice of $B$. We also show that there is a bijection between the localizing ideals of $D(RB)$ and the stable subsets of $\Spec R\times L_B$. As a consequence, the telescope conjecture holds for $D(RB)$.
